column1: # The model weights the app runs, pinned: where each file lands under models/, where it
# comes from, how many bytes, and its sha256. scripts/fetch_models.sh and .ps1 read this;
# moving a pin is an edit here and nowhere else. Columns are tab-separated.
# Licences (the text of each is under installer/LICENSES/):
#   embeddinggemma  Gemma Terms of Use, https://ai.google.dev/gemma/terms -- the knowledge
#                   base's embedder; the drop's vectors were made by the same model
#   phonon          Apache-2.0 (Gradium's Phonon 31M English, its Mimi decoder and the voice
#                   phonon-voices) -- the souls' voices, as the ONNX Runtime graphs Moonshine's
#                   exporter makes, from Moonshine's download server. The folder keeps the name
#                   "phonon": the framework's engine reads <models>/phonon/... The app speaks
#                   it through the Moonshine library (src/phonon.cpp). scripts/fetch_phonon.*
#                   makes the same folder from source, for when the pins are not enough
#                   (the server's folder is not versioned: a re-export there changes the
#                   bytes, and these pins then need moving).
#   llm             Apache-2.0 (Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507, unsloth's Q4_K_M GGUF) -- the talker
#   stt             MIT (Moonshine medium-streaming-en, 2026-08-21 export) -- the ear. The
#                   export's decoder_kv_with_attention.ort (140 MB) is left out: the app
#                   asks for no word timestamps, which is all that file serves.
